name: clanker-skills
description: Reusable Claude Code tooling for understanding other repositories. Ships the Skills & Prompts Explorer: a build-explorer skill that discovers every skill, agent, and prompt in any repo and generates a self-contained, browsable static site with assessment cards and clickable, source-linked workflow diagrams.

plugins.name: skills-explorer
plugins.description: Discovers every skill, agent, prompt-template, system-prompt, and instruction doc in a repository and builds a self-contained, dependency-light static explorer: each artifact gets a structured assessment card, a programmatic-surface panel (tool grants, MCP servers, invocation mode, bundled resources), and a generated workflow diagram whose steps slice their verbatim source section.
